description: Ministry of Provincial Council, Local Government and Sports - Notice of amendment by adding new sport class "Power Boat" to the Sports Act, published in Gaz. Ex. No. 1990/23 of 27.10.2016
reasoning: This gazette content is an order made under the Sports Act, No. 25 of 1973, which amends a previous order by adding a new sport/sport class to a schedule. This constitutes a regulatory matter involving the modification of subsidiary legislation under an existing Act, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) for regulatory frameworks and statutory instruments.
